summary: Shoshone County, Idaho lookout on the St. Joe National Forest: a camp listed in 1934, an L-4 tower in 1938, destroyed in 1952. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1952; no source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: Listed as a camp; the sources give no further detail

evidence.supports: on the St. Joe National Forest

notes_for_editor: Both sources give the same three dates and probably share an origin, so they are not independent confirmation. No source describes the site today or gives access or height; access and visit are left out. Elevation 4490 ft is on both firelookout.com and idahofirelookouts.com (the second in the page header), so it is now a facts key (elevation_ft) and the story cites both sources for it. Record coordinates are consistent with '14 miles ENE of St. Maries'. Record status 'gone' and event 1952 are supported. Story is short because the evidence is thin.
